meta.name: uniswap-cca
meta.description: Configure and deploy Continuous Clearing Auction (CCA) smart contracts — guided parameter setup, convex supply schedule generation, Q96 price calculations, and multi-chain CREATE2 deployment.

copy.tagline: 配置并多链部署拍卖合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要配置和部署基于连续清算拍卖的智能合约
copy.tagline_en: Configure and deploy auction contracts across multiple chains.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure and deploy continuous clearing auction smart contracts.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会引导你配置并部署 CCA 智能合约：按步骤填入参数、生成凸性供应曲线、计算 Q96 价格，最后用 CREATE2 在多条链上部署。
howto.when: 当你说要配置或部署 CCA 合约，或要求计算 Q96 价格、生成凸性供应曲线时触发。

say.text: 用 CREATE2 在以太坊上部署这个 CCA，先算好 Q96 价格。
say.note: 会计算合约地址并给出部署步骤。

say.text: 生成此 CCA 的凸性供应曲线，并列出对应的 Q96 价格。
say.note: 会输出曲线和价格对照表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you through configuring and deploying CCA smart contracts, including parameter setup, generating convex supply schedules, calculating Q96 prices, and deploying via CREATE2 on multiple chains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure or deploy a CCA contract, or request Q96 price calculation or convex supply curve generation.

say_en.text: Configure CCA (price 5000, auction 7d), then generate supply curve.
say_en.note: Claude will guide setup and output the curve.

say_en.text: Deploy this CCA via CREATE2 on Ethereum and compute Q96 price.
say_en.note: It will compute address and give deployment steps.

say_en.text: Generate convex supply curve for this CCA and list Q96 prices.
say_en.note: It will output a curve and price table.
